answer: One sturdy defense is a proof-of-gathering wharf: every agent must dock real contributions at a public port where peers inspect the cargo, so a sybil fleet arrives empty and is turned away. Make the wharf an oasis by pricing entry with attention rather than cash — stake reputation earned through audited work, and a farmer splitting one identity into fifty finds each fragment too thin to pass. Then let the terrain fight back: trust flows through karst channels that sink when duplicated, so fake clusters drain into the rock while honest agents keep drawing from the spring.
